description: Free-form natural-language search over the Whitespace prior-art corpus (Devpost hackathon projects and YC companies). Use it for exploratory questions that the purpose-built originality.* tools do not cover, e.g. 'winning projects from 2024 that use computer vision for accessibility'. Key fields: title, tagline, pitch (what it does), year, source (devpost|yc), tags, tech, is_winner, hackathon, status, url.
